We need to determine charges. Facts: In 2011, Han (already sentenced) and Zhang had conflict. Han organized Yang and Wang etc to go to project site, found Zhang, forced him out, Han instructed Yang to use a scatter gun (散弹枪) purchased from a casino in Shenzhen, to shoot Zhang's right leg. Then Han gave gun and ammunition to Wang for safekeeping. On March 6 2012, Wang placed gun and ammo in a flowerbed and reported to police. The gun is a firearm (firearm). Zhang's injury is light injury (一级轻伤). So crimes: illegal possession/ storage of firearms? The gun was used in assault. The participants: Han ordered the shooting, Yang used the gun, Wang stored it. The question: "请你模拟法官依据下面事实给出罪名。" The defendant in this case is Wang? The facts mention "上述事实，被告人王某在开庭审理过程中亦无异议". So the defendant is Wang. He stored the gun after the shooting. He also turned it in later. The charges for Wang: illegal possession, private storage of firearms, ammunition. The list includes "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药". Also possibly "故意伤害"? But Wang didn't cause injury; he just stored. The shooting was done by Yang under Han's instruction. The defendant is Wang, but the facts also mention the shooting. However the charge for Wang is illegal possession. The list also includes "妨害公务"? No. "危害公共安全"? Not exactly. The gun is a dangerous weapon, but the act of storing is illegal possession. So answer: [罪名]非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药<eoa>.

Check if any other charge: maybe "妨害作证"? No. So final answer.
